meta.title: Good Word: show and movie recs from your friends
meta.description: A private shelf of shows and movies your friends vouch for. No algorithm, no strangers.

hero.headline: Take your friends' word for it.
hero.subhead: A private shelf of shows and movies your friends vouch for. No algorithm. No strangers. Just your people.
hero.phoneAlt: A group shelf for College crew showing four shows and movies with the friends who vouched for them.
hero.quote: ep 3 is where it gets you. trust me.

problem.headline: You asked the group chat what to watch.
problem.body: Three days later, one reply. It was a link to a trailer. Meanwhile the algorithm still thinks you want another true-crime documentary because you watched one in 2022.
problem.algorithmCaption: Because you watched Baking Showdown: Season 4
problem.friendQuote: ok you need to watch The Night Ferry. it's strange and perfect.

how.headline: Three things. That's the whole app.
how.step1Body: Search a title, tap once, add a note if you like. About ten seconds.
how.step1Alt: Putting in a good word for The Night Ferry, with the note “ep 3 is where it gets you”, visible to 2 groups and 11 people.
how.step2Title: It lands on your groups' shelves.
how.step2Body: College friends, the group chat, your book club. Each group keeps its own shelf.
how.step2Alt: Two shelves, College crew and The girls, each showing The Night Ferry.
how.step3Body: Filter by mood, length, and where it's streaming, and every pick still has a friend's name on it.
how.step3Alt: A shelf filtered to comedy, under 2 hours, on Netflix, showing three picks and who vouched for each.

groups.headline: Different friends, different taste.
groups.body: You'd trust your film friend on a slow Korean thriller and your sister on a comfort rewatch. Keep a separate shelf for each circle.

talk.headline: Finished it? Say so.
talk.body: Every title on your shelf has a conversation, just for that group. Mention a friend to pull them in. Mark spoilers so nobody gets ruined.
talk.phoneAlt: A conversation about The Night Ferry in College crew: Tess says she just finished episode 6 and mentions Priya, Mo's comment is covered as a spoiler, and the comment box says “Say something to College crew…”.
talk.note: Conversations stay inside the group. No one else can see them.

humans.headline: Humans only.
humans.lead1: Every pick has a name on it.
humans.rest1: If it's on the shelf, a friend put it there.
humans.rest2: Nothing is logged unless you choose to vouch for it.
humans.rest3: If none of your friends have vouched for a short horror movie yet, we'll just tell you.

isnt.label: What Good Word isn't
isnt.summary: Good Word has no star ratings, public profiles, followers, endless feeds, or reviews.

faq.headline: Questions
faq.a1: No. Groups are private and invite-only. Only people in a group can see its shelf and its conversations.
faq.a2: Shows and movies to start. Restaurants and “who's your plumber” may come later.
faq.q3: Do I have to log everything I watch?
faq.a3: No. Only what you'd recommend. It's a shelf of favorites, not a diary.
faq.q4: Can we talk about what we watched?
faq.a4: Yes. Every title has a conversation for your group, with mentions and spoiler covers.
faq.a5: Only behind the scenes, to match titles and fill in details. It never recommends anything on its own.
faq.a6: We're building it now. Coming soon.

closing.headline: Your friends already have great taste.
closing.subhead: Good Word makes sure none of it gets lost.

footer.madeBy: Made by people who ask their friends what to watch.
